subject.title: fix #95295: [Bug]: Web UI sidebar hides existing child-spawned subagent sessions across agent scopes

question: Should the linked bug be fixed by this sidebar-only default-off All agents mode, or by a broader Sessions-table or gateway-level cross-agent visibility model?
rationale: The code path is a plausible narrow repair, but sibling candidates make the permanent product boundary a maintainer choice rather than a purely mechanical review decision.

options.title: Land sidebar-only mode
options.body: Keep the default scoped sidebar behavior, add explicit sidebar All agents discovery, and require real UI proof before merge.

options.title: Broaden the visibility model
options.body: Use a wider Sessions table or gateway-level design if maintainers want cross-agent child sessions to be a general sessions.list concept.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Close or defer this candidate if maintainers do not want a new sidebar scope control in core UI.

recommendation.title: Land sidebar-only mode
recommendation.body: Keep the default scoped sidebar behavior, add explicit sidebar All agents discovery, and require real UI proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter most recently introduced the current Control UI component structure and session helper surface this PR targets.
